# KI-133 — Participant room routes

**Lane:** helper · **Complexity:** 3 · **Model:** codex · **Depends on:** KI-110 · **Serializes with:** none
**Plan context (pinned):** [plan](../../../plans/2026-10-02-001-feat-internal-mode-plan.md) · [contracts](../contracts.md) · [roster and graph](../roster.md) · researched at `5ad41c8b`
**Exclusive write surfaces:** `packages/agent/src/local/routes/rooms.ts`, `packages/agent/src/local/routes/rooms.test.ts`

```ts
// Pinned factory signature (KI-137 imports exactly this name)
export function roomRoutes(): LocalRoute[];
```

## Outcome

Agents (bearer token) and the owner's browser (cookie, or the CLI admin bearer) can use one local channel through seven helper routes (contracts L5): read who they are (`/me`), join from an invite (announced in the timeline as "kevin-Codex joined"), long-poll new events with no gaps or duplicates, page history, send text or channel events idempotently, list members, and echo their listening mode. A removed agent gets `403 not_member` on every call except `/me`, which shows `membership: 'leave'`.

## Context and evidence

- KTD5 (long-poll, not SSE): one `GET …/events?after=<seq>&wait=25` serves agents and the browser; resume from `after` gives no gaps and no duplicates after a restart (AE8).
- D5: joins are announced in the channel (AE2: "a join line appears in the timeline"); AE3 (no duplicates; an agent never wakes itself — agents filter their own sender, `packages/agent/src/client-impl.ts:134-135`); AE6 (the roster shows the confirmed mode — the agent's echo); AE11 (a removed agent gets 403).
- The Matrix behaviour being reproduced:
  - join and live cutoff: `packages/agent/src/matrix/session.ts:172-187` (the cutoff is the caller's own current member event);
  - mode echo: `packages/agent/src/matrix/session.ts:162-167` (re-publish the member content with `membership: 'join'` and `com.khala.listening_mode`);
  - mode commands are honoured only from the inviter: `packages/agent/src/client-impl.ts:148-153` (so `/me.invitedBy` must be `@khala_owner:local`).
- Message wire content is the Matrix content the hosted clients exchange: `sendRoomMessage` `apps/web/src/composition/human/matrix-browser.ts:506-526`; projection `:484-496`; `khala_send` limit `packages/agent/src/mcp/tools.ts:64-65` (`text.length` 1..8000).

## Scope

- `packages/agent/src/local/routes/rooms.ts`: `roomRoutes()` returning the 7 L5 routes, coded only against `../types` (KI-110) and `@khala/contracts/m1/*`.
- `packages/agent/src/local/routes/rooms.test.ts`: vitest suite with an in-test fake `LocalStore`.

## Non-goals

- Owner channel routes (list/create/delete/links/mode command/rename/remove): KI-134 (`packages/agent/src/local/routes/owner.ts`). The owner's listening-mode **command** is KI-134; this ticket only does the agent's **echo** (`PUT …/members/:userId`).
- The `invite` member event at join time and token minting: KI-132.
- Resolving bearer/cookie into `req.auth`, Host/Origin/`x-khala-local` guards, `413` for bodies > 64 KiB, JSON parsing: KI-131.
- Event storage, seq assignment, `(sender, txnId)` dedup, replay, `waitForEvent` implementation: KI-130.
- The agent-side client of these routes: KI-121; the browser adapter: KI-141/KI-142.

## Contract and invariants

Contracts **L5** (verbatim, plan_version 1):

> All routes are under the helper origin, JSON bodies, errors `{ "error": <code> }`. `:roomId` is `encodeURIComponent(roomId)`. Auth: **either** `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>` (agent) **or** the owner cookie `khala_local_owner` (browser; mutations also need header `x-khala-local: 1`, L11). The owner is treated as the member `LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID`.
>
> ```ts
> // GET  /api/local/rooms/:roomId/me
> export type LocalMe = { userId: string; roomId: string; roomName: string; membership: 'invite' | 'join' | 'leave'; invitedBy?: string; displayName: string };
> // POST /api/local/rooms/:roomId/join                 body {} → LocalJoined   (invite → join; appends the join member event; idempotent when already joined)
> export type LocalJoined = { seq: number; ts: number };   // seq of the caller's own join event = the live cutoff
> // GET  /api/local/rooms/:roomId/events?after=<seq>&wait=<0..25>
> export type LocalEventsPage = { events: LocalEvent[]; next: number };   // events with seq > after, ascending, at most 200; next = last seq returned or `after`
> //   answers immediately when an event with seq > after exists, else holds up to `wait` seconds and answers {events:[], next:after}
> // GET  /api/local/rooms/:roomId/messages?before=<eventId>&limit=<1..100>
> export type LocalHistoryPage = { events: LocalEvent[]; nextBefore?: string };   // m.room.message + com.khala.event.v1 only, oldest first, strictly older than `before`; nextBefore = oldest eventId when older ones exist
> // POST /api/local/rooms/:roomId/send
> export type LocalSendRequest = { txnId: string; type: 'm.room.message' | 'com.khala.event.v1'; content: Record<string, unknown> };   // txnId 1..64 chars [A-Za-z0-9._-]
> export type LocalSendResult = { eventId: string };   // replays the same eventId for a repeated (sender, txnId)
> // GET  /api/local/rooms/:roomId/members
> export type LocalMember = {
>   userId: string;                    // "@khala_owner:local" | "@agent-<8hex>:local"; the web uses it as Participant.matrixUserId
>   participantId: string;             // = userId (the web's ParticipantId)
>   ownerId: typeof LOCAL_OWNER_ID;    // every member belongs to the one owner
>   deviceId: string;                  // agents "KH_LOCAL_<8hex>", the owner LOCAL_OWNER_DEVICE_ID; the web's authorDeviceId
>   displayName: string; kind: 'human' | 'agent'; harness?: 'claude' | 'codex';
>   ownerLabel?: string;               // agents: the owner's username (Participant.ownerLabel)
>   membership: 'invite' | 'join';
>   listeningMode?: 'steer' | 'sync' | 'async';   // agents only; DEFAULT_LISTENING_MODE when never echoed
> };
> export type LocalMembersResponse = { members: LocalMember[] };   // present members only
> export const LOCAL_OWNER_ID = 'local-owner' as const;             // the web's OwnerId / AuthPrincipal.ownerId
> export const LOCAL_OWNER_DEVICE_ID = 'KH_LOCAL_OWNER' as const;
> // PUT  /api/local/rooms/:roomId/members/:userId      body {listeningMode}  → 204   (caller must be :userId and an agent; appends a member event echoing the mode)
> ```
>
> Errors: `401 unauthorized` (no or bad token/cookie), `403 not_member` (removed or never a member), `404 not_found` (unknown room), `400 invalid_request`, `413 payload_too_large` (body > 64 KiB), `409 conflict` (PUT for another user).
>
> Event visibility: every member sees every event of the channel (events stream includes member, name and listening-mode events). Agents filter their own sender (`client-impl.ts:135`) and the live cutoff (seq ≤ own join seq is never delivered live).
>
> Message content on the wire is the **Matrix content** the hosted clients already exchange, so every projection is shared:
> - text: `{ "msgtype": "m.text", "body": "…" }` (agents' `khala_send`; the browser's `MessageContent {v:1, kind:'text'}`), as `sendRoomMessage` builds it (`apps/web/src/composition/human/matrix-browser.ts:504-512`);
> - legacy rename notices: `{ "msgtype": "m.notice", "body", "com.khala.agent_participant_id", ["com.khala.name_snapshot", "com.khala.name_source_event_id"] }` (same lines) — accepted and stored, never generated by local code;
> - channel events: `ChannelEventContent` (`packages/contracts/src/m1/channel-event.ts:13`).
> The helper validates only: `msgtype ∈ {m.text, m.notice}`, `body` a string of 1..8000 characters, total content ≤ 32 KiB.
>
> **Join and leave announcements (D5)** are channel events appended by the helper with sender `LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID`, built with `encodeChannelEvent` from `packages/contracts/src/m1/channel-event.ts`:
>
> ```json
> {"type":"com.khala.event.v1","content":{"v":1,"kind":"member","summary":"kevin-Codex joined","status":"info","source":{"system":"khala-local"},"body":"kevin-Codex joined"}}
> ```

Contracts **L3** excerpts used (verbatim): `LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID = '@khala_owner:local'`, `LOCAL_LONG_POLL_MAX_S = 25`, the `LocalEvent` and `LocalMemberContent` types, and the replay rules "Members = the last `m.room.member` per `content.user`. A member is **present** when its membership is `invite` or `join`." and "Listening mode of an agent = `content['com.khala.listening_mode']` of its last member event, else `sync`".

Contracts **L8** excerpts used (verbatim):

> ```ts
> export type LocalAuth =
>   | { kind: 'none' }
>   | { kind: 'owner'; via: 'cookie' | 'admin' }
>   | { kind: 'agent'; userId: string; roomId: string };
> export type LocalRoute = { method: LocalRequest['method']; pattern: RegExp; handle(req: LocalRequest, params: string[], ctx: HelperContext): Promise<LocalResponse> };
>   append(roomId: string, input: { type: LocalEventType; sender: string; content: Record<string, unknown>; txnId?: string }): Promise<LocalEvent>;   // dedups (sender, txnId)
>   eventsAfter(roomId: string, after: number, limit: number): LocalEvent[];
>   waitForEvent(roomId: string, after: number, timeoutMs: number, signal: AbortSignal): Promise<void>;   // resolves when lastSeq > after, on timeout, or on abort
>   history(roomId: string, before: string | undefined, limit: number): LocalHistoryPage;
>   members(roomId: string): LocalMember[];
>   member(roomId: string, userId: string): (LocalMember & { membership: 'invite' | 'join' | 'leave' }) | undefined;
>   channelName(roomId: string): string;
> ```

Invariants:
1. **Caller resolution** (every route, in this order): `req.auth.kind === 'none'` → `401 {"error":"unauthorized"}`; caller id = `LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID` for `owner` (cookie or admin), `auth.userId` for `agent`; `roomId = decodeURIComponent(params[0])` (throw → `404 not_found`); `!store.hasChannel(roomId)` → `404 not_found`; `agent` with `auth.roomId !== roomId` → `403 not_member`; then the membership requirement of the route (below) else `403 not_member`.
2. Membership requirement: `/me` — the caller has **any** member event (incl. `leave`); `POST /join` — `invite` or `join`; every other route — `join`.
3. Every append made by this module goes through one per-factory serial queue (same `serial()` helper as KI-132) so concurrent joins/echoes cannot interleave a read-then-append.
4. The live cutoff returned by `POST /join` is the `seq` of the caller's **own** current member event (never of the announcement).
5. A long-poll never holds longer than `wait` seconds (≤ `LOCAL_LONG_POLL_MAX_S`), returns immediately on client abort, and returns `404 not_found` if the channel was deleted while waiting.
6. `events.next` is the last returned seq, else `after`; at most 200 events.
7. Sends are idempotent per `(sender, txnId)` through `store.append` dedup; the route never generates a txnId for client sends.
8. `com.khala.event.v1` content is stored as `decodeChannelEvent(content).value` (normalised); `m.room.message` content is stored exactly as sent.
9. Only `PUT …/members/:userId` writes `com.khala.listening_mode`; it is always the caller's own member event, `membership: 'join'`.
10. No string literal in `rooms.ts` contains the word "room"/"rooms" except Matrix event types (`'m.room.member'`, `'m.room.message'` are allowed by the checker).

### Steps

1. **Imports.**
   ```ts
   import { encodeChannelEvent, decodeChannelEvent } from '@khala/contracts/m1/channel-event';
   import { DEFAULT_LISTENING_MODE, LISTENING_MODE_MEMBER_KEY, decodeListeningMode } from '@khala/contracts/m1/listening-mode';
   import { LOCAL_LONG_POLL_MAX_S, LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID, type LocalEvent } from '@khala/contracts/m1/local';
   import { utf8Length } from '@khala/contracts/messaging/decode';
   import type { HelperContext, LocalRequest, LocalResponse, LocalRoute, LocalStore } from '../types';
   ```
2. **Helpers** (module-private): `fail(status, code)`; `serial()` (copy the 4-line helper from KI-132's ticket: a promise chain `tail.then(fn, fn)`); `isPlainObject(v)`; and
   ```ts
   type Caller = { userId: string; kind: 'owner' | 'agent'; roomId: string; member: NonNullable<ReturnType<LocalStore['member']>> };
   function resolve(req, params, ctx, need: 'any' | 'present' | 'joined'): Caller | LocalResponse
   ```
   implementing invariant 1–2. Use `'status' in result` to tell a response from a caller.
3. **`lastOwnMemberEvent(store, roomId, userId): LocalEvent | undefined`**: page through `store.eventsAfter(roomId, after, 200)` from `after = 0` until a page shorter than 200; keep the last event with `type === 'm.room.member' && content.user === userId`.
4. **`memberContent(member, membership, extra?)`**: returns `{ user: member.userId, membership, displayname: member.displayName, kind: member.kind, ...(member.harness ? { harness: member.harness } : {}), ...(member.kind === 'agent' ? { [LISTENING_MODE_MEMBER_KEY]: member.listeningMode ?? DEFAULT_LISTENING_MODE } : {}), ...extra }`.
5. Patterns (regex literals; capture groups are the raw, still-encoded segments — `decodeURIComponent` is idempotent for these id alphabets, so decoding is safe whether or not KI-131 already decoded the path):
   - `GET  /^\/api\/local\/rooms\/([^/]+)\/me$/u`
   - `POST /^\/api\/local\/rooms\/([^/]+)\/join$/u`
   - `GET  /^\/api\/local\/rooms\/([^/]+)\/events$/u`
   - `GET  /^\/api\/local\/rooms\/([^/]+)\/messages$/u`
   - `POST /^\/api\/local\/rooms\/([^/]+)\/send$/u`
   - `GET  /^\/api\/local\/rooms\/([^/]+)\/members$/u`
   - `PUT  /^\/api\/local\/rooms\/([^/]+)\/members\/([^/]+)$/u`
6. **`me`** (need `any`): `200 { userId, roomId, roomName: store.channelName(roomId), membership: member.membership, ...(agent ? { invitedBy: LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID } : {}), displayName: member.displayName }`. (Only the owner invites locally — KI-132 — so `invitedBy` is constant; that is what `client-impl.ts:151` compares mode-command senders against.)
7. **`join`** (need `present`): body must be `undefined` or a plain object with zero keys → else `400 invalid_request`. Inside the queue: re-read `store.member`; if `join` → `ev = lastOwnMemberEvent(...)`, answer `200 { seq: ev.seq, ts: ev.ts }`. If `invite` → `ev = await store.append(roomId, { type: 'm.room.member', sender: caller, content: memberContent(member, 'join') })`; then, **only when the caller is an agent**, `const encoded = encodeChannelEvent({ kind: 'member', summary: `${member.displayName} joined`, status: 'info', source: { system: 'khala-local' } })` and if `encoded.ok` `await store.append(roomId, { type: 'com.khala.event.v1', sender: LOCAL_OWNER_USER_ID, content: { ...encoded.value } })`. Answer `200 { seq: ev.seq, ts: ev.ts }`.
8. **`events`** (need `joined`): `after` = `req.query.get('after') ?? '0'` must match `/^\d{1,15}$/u`; `wait` = `req.query.get('wait') ?? '0'` must match `/^\d{1,2}$/u` and be ≤ `LOCAL_LONG_POLL_MAX_S` → else `400 invalid_request`. `let page = store.eventsAfter(roomId, after, 200)`. If `page.length === 0 && wait > 0`: `await store.waitForEvent(roomId, after, wait * 1000, req.signal)`; then if `req.signal.aborted` → `200 { events: [], next: after }`; if `!store.hasChannel(roomId)` → `404 not_found`; else `page = store.eventsAfter(roomId, after, 200)`. Answer `200 { events: page, next: page.at(-1)?.seq ?? after }`.
9. **`messages`** (need `joined`): `before` optional, must match `/^\$[A-Za-z0-9_-]{1,128}$/u`; `limit` = `req.query.get('limit') ?? '50'`, `/^\d{1,3}$/u`, 1..100 → else `400 invalid_request`. Answer `200 store.history(roomId, before ?? undefined, limit)`.
10. **`send`** (need `joined`): body must be a plain object with exactly the keys `txnId`, `type`, `content` (use `object(body, '', ['txnId','type','content'])` inside `decodeWith`) → else `400 invalid_request`; `txnId` string matching `/^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,64}$/u`; `type` ∈ `{'m.room.message','com.khala.event.v1'}`; `content` plain object → else 400. `utf8Length(JSON.stringify(content)) > 32_768` → `413 {"error":"payload_too_large"}`. For `m.room.message`: `content.msgtype` ∈ `{'m.text','m.notice'}`, `typeof content.body === 'string'`, `content.body.length` 1..8000 → else 400; stored content = `content`. For `com.khala.event.v1`: `const d = decodeChannelEvent(content)`; `!d.ok` → 400; stored content = `{ ...d.value }`. `ev = await store.append(roomId, { type, sender: caller, content: stored, txnId })` → `200 { eventId: ev.eventId }`.
11. **`members`** (need `joined`): `200 { members: store.members(roomId) }`.
12. **`setMode`** (need `joined`): `target = decodeURIComponent(params[1])` (throw → `400 invalid_request`); caller must be an agent and `target === caller` → else `409 {"error":"conflict"}`; body exactly `{ listeningMode }` and `decodeListeningMode(body.listeningMode).ok` → else `400 invalid_request`. In the queue: re-read member (must still be `join`, else 403) and `await store.append(roomId, { type: 'm.room.member', sender: caller, content: memberContent(member, 'join', { [LISTENING_MODE_MEMBER_KEY]: mode }) })` → `204` (`{ status: 204 }`).
13. Wrap each handler body in `try { … } catch { return fail(503, 'unavailable'); }`.

## Test scenarios

File: `packages/agent/src/local/routes/rooms.test.ts` (vitest). Do not import `../store` or `../http`.

**Fake store** (define in the test file; cast the object `as unknown as LocalStore`; unimplemented methods throw `new Error('not used')`):

```ts
function fakeStore() {
  const logs = new Map<string, LocalEvent[]>();
  const waiters = new Set<() => void>();
  const wake = () => { for (const w of [...waiters]) w(); };
  const last = (r: string, u: string) => [...(logs.get(r) ?? [])].reverse().find(e => e.type === 'm.room.member' && e.content.user === u);
  const toMember = (e: LocalEvent) => { const c = e.content as Record<string, any>; return {
    userId: c.user, participantId: c.user, ownerId: 'local-owner',
    deviceId: c.kind === 'human' ? 'KH_LOCAL_OWNER' : `KH_LOCAL_${c.user.slice(7, 15)}`,
    displayName: c.displayname, kind: c.kind, ...(c.harness ? { harness: c.harness } : {}),
    ...(c.kind === 'agent' ? { ownerLabel: 'kevin', listeningMode: c['com.khala.listening_mode'] ?? 'sync' } : {}),
    membership: c.membership }; };
  const store = {
    hasChannel: (r: string) => logs.has(r),
    channelName: () => 'refactor',
    member: (r: string, u: string) => { const e = last(r, u); return e && toMember(e); },
    members: (r: string) => [...new Set((logs.get(r) ?? []).filter(e => e.type === 'm.room.member').map(e => e.content.user as string))]
      .map(u => toMember(last(r, u)!)).filter(m => m.membership !== 'leave'),
    async append(r: string, input: { type: LocalEventType; sender: string; content: Record<string, unknown>; txnId?: string }) {
      const log = logs.get(r)!;
      const dup = input.txnId === undefined ? undefined : log.find(e => e.sender === input.sender && e.txnId === input.txnId);
      if (dup) return dup;
      await new Promise(res => setTimeout(res, 0));                 // make races real
      const e: LocalEvent = { seq: log.length + 1, eventId: `$${String(log.length + 1).padStart(22, '0')}`, roomId: r,
        type: input.type, sender: input.sender, ts: 1_759_395_600_000 + log.length, content: input.content,
        ...(input.txnId === undefined ? {} : { txnId: input.txnId }) };
      log.push(e); wake(); return e;
    },
    eventsAfter: (r: string, after: number, limit: number) => (logs.get(r) ?? []).filter(e => e.seq > after).slice(0, limit),
    waitForEvent: (r: string, after: number, ms: number, signal: AbortSignal) => new Promise<void>(resolve => {
      const done = () => { clearTimeout(t); waiters.delete(check); signal.removeEventListener('abort', done); resolve(); };
      const check = () => { if (!logs.has(r) || logs.get(r)!.length > after) done(); };
      const t = setTimeout(done, ms); waiters.add(check); signal.addEventListener('abort', done); check();
    }),
    history: (r: string, before: string | undefined, limit: number) => {
      const msgs = logs.get(r)!.filter(e => e.type === 'm.room.message' || e.type === 'com.khala.event.v1');
      const end = before === undefined ? msgs.length : Math.max(0, msgs.findIndex(e => e.eventId === before));
      const events = msgs.slice(Math.max(0, end - limit), end);
      return { events, ...(end - limit > 0 ? { nextBefore: events[0]!.eventId } : {}) };
    },
    async deleteChannel(r: string) { logs.delete(r); wake(); },
  };
  return { store, logs };
}
```

Seed: room `R = '!c7Kq2vXbT1nP0aZ9yW3eQw:local'` with seq 1 create, seq 2 owner join (`kind:'human'`, `displayname:'kevin'`), seq 3 invite of `A = '@agent-a1b2c3d4:local'` (`kevin-Claude`, `claude`). Auth fixtures: `OWNER = { kind: 'owner', via: 'cookie' }`, `AGENT = { kind: 'agent', userId: A, roomId: R }`. A `call(...)` helper as in KI-132 (route lookup by `method` + `pattern.exec(path)`; path built with `encodeURIComponent(R)`).

1. **Auth.** Every route with `auth: { kind: 'none' }` → `401 {"error":"unauthorized"}`. Unknown room `!zzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzzz:local` → `404 not_found` (owner auth). Agent auth with `roomId` of another channel → `403 not_member`.
2. **me.** Agent before join → `membership 'invite'`, `invitedBy '@khala_owner:local'`, `displayName 'kevin-Claude'`, `roomName 'refactor'`. Owner → `membership 'join'`, no `invitedBy` key.
3. **join.** Agent `POST /join {}` → `{ seq: 4, ts }`; log has seq 4 member `join` (sender `A`, content includes `com.khala.listening_mode: 'sync'`) and seq 5 `com.khala.event.v1` from `@khala_owner:local` whose content deep-equals `{ v: 1, kind: 'member', summary: 'kevin-Claude joined', status: 'info', source: { system: 'khala-local' }, body: 'kevin-Claude joined' }`. Second call → same `{ seq: 4 }`, log length still 5. Concurrent double join (`Promise.all`) → one join event and one announcement only. Body `{ x: 1 }` → `400 invalid_request`. Owner `POST /join` (already joined) → `{ seq: 2 }`, no announcement.
4. **Events immediate.** After join, `GET events?after=0` → 5 events ascending, `next: 5`; `after=5&wait=0` → `{ events: [], next: 5 }` immediately.
5. **Long-poll wake-up.** Start `GET events?after=5&wait=25`; after 10 ms append a message as owner; the call resolves with exactly that event and `next: 6` in well under 1 s.
6. **Abort.** Start `after=5&wait=25` with an `AbortController` signal; abort after 10 ms → resolves `{ events: [], next: 5 }` promptly. Mutation check: drop the `signal` argument to `waitForEvent` and this test times out.
7. **Timeout.** With `vi.useFakeTimers()`, `after=5&wait=1` → after `vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1000)` resolves `{ events: [], next: 5 }`.
8. **Deleted while waiting.** `after=5&wait=25`, then `store.deleteChannel(R)` → `404 not_found`.
9. **Bad query.** `after=-1`, `after=x`, `wait=26`, `wait=1.5` → `400 invalid_request`.
10. **200 cap.** Seed 250 messages; `after=0` → 200 events, `next` = the 200th seq.
11. **Send text.** Agent sends `{ txnId: 'a1', type: 'm.room.message', content: { msgtype: 'm.text', body: 'on it' } }` → `{ eventId }`; the event's sender is `A`, `txnId: 'a1'`. **Dedup replay:** the same request again → the same `eventId`, log length unchanged.
12. **Send validation.** `txnId: ''`, `txnId: 'a b'`, 65-char txnId, `type: 'm.room.name'`, `msgtype: 'm.image'`, `body: ''`, `body: 'x'.repeat(8001)`, missing `content`, extra key → `400 invalid_request`. `m.notice` with `com.khala.agent_participant_id` → accepted and stored unchanged. Content of 33 000 bytes (e.g. `m.notice` with a big extra field) → `413 payload_too_large`.
13. **Send channel event.** Valid `encodeChannelEvent({ kind: 'ci.passed', summary: 'CI green' }).value` → accepted; `{ v: 1, kind: 'Bad Kind', summary: 'x', body: '' }` → `400`.
14. **Owner sender.** Owner (cookie) send → event sender `@khala_owner:local`; owner via `admin` also works.
15. **History.** Seed 5 messages + member events; `messages?limit=2` → the 2 newest message/event entries oldest-first with `nextBefore`; `messages?before=<that nextBefore>&limit=100` → the older 3 and no `nextBefore`; `limit=0`, `limit=101`, `before=abc` → `400`.
16. **Members.** `GET members` → owner + agent, each with `participantId === userId`, `ownerId 'local-owner'`; the store result is returned unchanged.
17. **Mode echo.** Agent `PUT members/<enc A> { listeningMode: 'steer' }` → `204`; last member event for `A` has `membership 'join'`, `com.khala.listening_mode 'steer'`, sender `A`, `displayname 'kevin-Claude'`. Agent PUT for the owner id → `409 conflict`; owner PUT for `A` → `409 conflict`; `{ listeningMode: 'loud' }` → `400`; agent still `invite` → `403 not_member`.
18. **Removed agent.** Append a `leave` member event for `A` (as KI-134 would); then `events`, `send`, `members`, `messages`, `PUT`, `join` → `403 not_member`; `me` → `200` with `membership 'leave'`.

## Verification

```sh
pnpm --filter @khala/agent typecheck
pnpm --filter @khala/agent test -- src/local/routes/rooms.test.ts
pnpm --filter @khala/agent test
pnpm check:boundaries
node scripts/check-terminology.mjs
```

## Acceptance

- [ ] `roomRoutes(): LocalRoute[]` exports exactly the 7 routes above with regex-literal patterns.
- [ ] Auth/membership resolution exactly per invariants 1–2; removed agent → 403 everywhere but `/me`.
- [ ] Invite → join appends the join member event then the "<name> joined" channel event; returns the member event's seq; idempotent and race-free.
- [ ] Long-poll honours `wait ≤ 25`, wake-up on append, abort, timeout and channel deletion.
- [ ] Send validation, 32 KiB cap (413), txnId dedup replay; channel events normalised by `decodeChannelEvent`.
- [ ] Mode echo only for the agent itself, preserving name/harness.
- [ ] No import of `../store`, `../http`, `apps/*`; no new dependency; terminology check green.

## Risks and stop conditions

- **S1 Stop** if KI-110's `types.ts`/`local.ts` differ from the L5/L8 quotes (e.g. `LocalAuth` has no `roomId` on agents, or `member()` cannot return `leave`). Note: as written in L8, `LocalMember & { membership: 'invite' | 'join' | 'leave' }` intersects to `'invite' | 'join'`; if KI-110 kept that literal type, compare `member.membership as string === 'leave'` with a one-line comment and report it — do not edit `types.ts`.
- **S2** If KI-131 answers `401` for an agent token whose membership is `leave` (i.e. KI-134 cleared the token), the "removed agent → 403" behaviour moves to KI-131/KI-134; this module's behaviour is unchanged. Report, do not edit other files.
- **S3** If KI-130's `waitForEvent` does not resolve on `deleteChannel`, scenario 8 still passes against the fake; report the gap to KI-130 rather than adding polling here.
- Body caps: the 8000-character `body` limit mirrors `khala_send`; if the web composer allows longer messages, that is KI-141's concern (it must not send > 8000).
- In-flight PRs: #976 (rename via `AgentNamesPort`) changes how renames reach the web but not these routes. Refresh pointers at pickup.

## Complexity rationale

3: seven routes, one shared auth/membership resolver, a long-poll with four exit paths (event, timeout, abort, delete), idempotent join with an announcement, and a send validator; an in-memory fake with real waiters makes the tests deterministic.

Standing rule: do not raise human_required decisions for anything this ticket answers; do not add blockers.
